top_reviews.title: Comfy but run a little small
top_reviews.text: These slippers are very comfy but run about a half size too small. I would suggest going a size up.

top_reviews.title: I wear 9 1/2, I bought 10 and it fits fine
top_reviews.text:
I didn't expect to like these. My idea was to try them on and send them back in exchange if they were either the wrong size or made in China. Well, neither of these were the case, so I have worn them for a day.
Olu Kai is a Hawaiian company, the slippers are made in Vietnam. The fit well, and are quite comfortable. I wear them with socks as my goal is to keep my feet warm. We don't wear "outdoor" shoes in the house, and just socks or even shoes that are only worn inside the house make my feet cold. These are breathable, so my feet don't get clammy, and just have just enough insulation to keep my feet warm.
As for the size, they don't make 9 1/2 so I went with 10 and the fit is fine with socks.
The styling is a little funky: they are not sleek. pointed toe, but rather rounded and there is no taper from back to front. I'm sure this adds to the comfort. The soles are flat and their is no heel, so it is a little like walking barefoot.
Enjoy!

top_reviews.title: Best Slippers ever
top_reviews.text: I work from home so I constantly wear slippers.  After maybe about 5-6 different pairs of other slippers wearing down and falling apart, I found the Olukai's.  They are definitely the best slipper I've even worn.  Craftmanship, comfort, look and durability are off the charts.  Buy these now if you're even thinking about getting a pair of slippers.

dialogue.user: Thanks, that’s helpful. I want to make sure they’ll work well for spending time outside, not just for quick trips to the mailbox.
dialogue.agent:
The "OLUKAI Kipuka Hulu Men's Leather Slippers, Premium Nubuck Leather Slip On Shoes, Shearling Lining & Gel Insert, Drop-In Heel Design" are designed as everyday slippers meant for both indoor and light outdoor use, such as stepping out for errands, getting the mail, or brief casual outings. They feature a rubber outsole with toe and heel bumpers for extra protection and durability outside, but they’re not specifically made for heavy outdoor activities like trail walking or light hiking. They offer comfort and protection for short outdoor adventures past the welcome mat, but wouldn’t be the best choice for extended time on rough terrain.
